text:
sam_db: Heads-up — planning a schema migration on payments.transactions tonight 00:30 UTC. We need a safepoint-compatible TTL backfill (old rows -> archived table) and a lock-minimizing apply. Target change window 30m. Can we avoid any global exclusive locks?

maria_sre: tagging oncall. what's the estimated row scan size? any hot partitions?

sam_db: ~120M rows, ~40M match TTL predicate. Primary hotspot is shard_04 (approx 50% of traffic). We'll run per-shard backfill with rate limiters. plan: split into 8 parallel workers, per-shard token bucket, pause on replication lag >30s.

eli_dev: for safety let's pin app deploy to v2.12 for the first hour post-migration. That avoids code path touching new archived column until we finish sweep. Can we set feature flag instead?

toni_release: agree on pinning. I'll create a short release note and set a route-level force-version in the router for 60m. Also adding a canary subset (10%) to exercise migration reads.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: infra/migrations/safepoint-ttl@2026-03-20T00:25Z initiated by sam_db
  - canary jobs: 2 instances
  - workers: 8
  - max_qps_per_worker: 40

sam_db: ops plan snippets:
```
# migration runner args
--shard=s4 --workers=8 --rate=200/s --safepoint=true --pause-on-lag=30s
# quick rollback: set --dry-run and stop workers; re-enable original row TTL via vacuum
```

zhen_prodops: please add the DB role pin and a maintenance marker so monitoring treats this as scheduled maintenance. I'll update the runbook with exact SLO thresholds.

maria_sre: rollback triggers we agreed:
- error spike >1% 5xx for write path sustained 3m
- replication lag >30s for any primary replica for 2m
- write latency p95 > 500ms for 5m
If any trigger hits, abort backfill and switch router to pinned-app v2.11 (safe fallback).

eli_dev: also add an automated feature-flag override to block movers if we see data divergence >0.1% on canary.

toni_release: release notes (short): "payments: TTL migration -> archived table. Short window, pinned app v2.12 for 60m. Monitor payments write latency and replication lag. Rollback triggers documented in thread." Will push to #announcements 00:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded (2/2). Migration worker bootstrap logs:
```
[INFO] boot worker s4-1
[INFO] leasing token bucket 200/s
[INFO] safepoint lock acquired (non-exclusive)
[WARN] slow shard hint: increasing backoff for shard_04
```

sam_db: starting per-shard sweep now. will post progress every 10m. first batch 0-5% complete in ~3m.

maria_sre: I'm on pager — will watch metrics and step in. @toni_release please be ready to flip router flag to v2.11 if maria asks. :thumbsup:

zhen_prodops: maintenance marker set in Grafana/Incidents with ETA +30m. Alert thresholds copied into runbook.

sam_db: 00:45 UTC update: 30% complete, shard_04 causing tail latency spikes, lowered per-worker rate to 80 QPS, added extra backoff. No replication lag observed.

eli_dev: update on client compatibility: added a short server-side guard to prevent reads from touching the new archived table for pinned versions. Good to proceed.

maria_sre: +1 continue. Keep me posted with any >10% progress jumps or error noise.

sam_db: 00:58 UTC — final sweep finishing, under plan. migration complete at 01:03 UTC. switching router to normal routing and removing pin in 5m if no regressions.

toni_release: pushed release note to #announcements and internal changelog. will announce rollback window closed in 10m if green.

deploy-bot: Migration job finished: 0 errors, duration 38m, archived_rows=40,112,934

maria_sre: final check: all metrics nominal, no replication lag, no error spikes. removing maintenance marker in 10m. thanks team. :party_popper:

sam_db: thanks all — postmortem draft on my plate, will include artifact links (logs, runbook, canary comparison).
